## Checklist

- [ ] Links an issue or accepted RFC
- [ ] Does **not** change L0 / L5 / public interfaces — **or** an accepted RFC is linked
- [ ] Every new persisted fact carries provenance
- [ ] Every numeric value has a unit
- [ ] Missing data is `unknown`, not a default
- [ ] Data license recorded in provenance (see `docs/05-licensing.md`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; CI is green
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO, `git commit -s`)
